## Use this when

- my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy
- our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works
- our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky
- customers cannot submit our lead form
- our website is painfully slow on mobile
- we inherited a messy codebase and are afraid to touch it
- an AI agency built our app and now it is unreliable or undocumented
- our SaaS works but barely and we need to stabilize it
- we need to migrate off an old platform without losing business behavior
- repair an existing system instead of replacing it
- find publicly observable conversion leaks before we pay for a rebuild
- broken checkout repair
- abandoned codebase rescue
- failed AI app repair
- legacy software rescue

## Problem

A business has existing software that still carries value but is broken, fragile, abandoned, slow, undocumented, or risky to change, and needs evidence before deciding whether to repair, modernize, migrate, or rebuild.

## Inputs

A public URL or customer-authorized system target, a description of the observed failure or business pain, and optional screenshots, logs, exports, or repository evidence the customer is authorized to share.

## Outputs

Observed failure inventory, evidence references, known-versus-unknown boundary, prioritized repair hypotheses, preserved-value map, and the smallest responsible next-step recommendation.
